semantics.clock: All sequential state updates occur on the rising edge of clk; one input byte is sampled per non-reset edge.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset takes priority, abandons any partial message, returns to searching, and makes done zero after the reset edge. No asynchronous reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: No power-up state specified; behavior is defined after a rising edge with reset asserted.
semantics.search: Discard bytes with in[3]=0 until a sampled byte has in[3]=1; that byte is message byte one.
semantics.message: The next two sampled bytes are bytes two and three regardless of all their bit values, including in[3].
semantics.done: done is high during the cycle immediately following the edge that samples byte three, and low otherwise. It is a one-cycle completion indication.
semantics.continuous_stream: At the edge ending the done cycle, the current input is examined as a potential first byte of the next message. No gap or discarded byte is inserted between messages.

numeric.input: Unsigned eight-bit byte; only bit 3 is used for boundary detection.
numeric.arithmetic: No payload arithmetic, signed interpretation, rounding, saturation, overflow, or byte storage is required.
numeric.state: Four FSM states can be encoded in two bits.

verification.oracle: Independent countdown model: zero means searching; a marker sets remaining bytes to two; each subsequent byte decrements the count; decrement from one produces done for the following cycle.
verification.directed: Check discarded nonmarkers, both values of bit 3 in payloads, contiguous messages, idle after completion, and reset at every message phase including completion.
verification.random: Compare every cycle over deterministic pseudorandom byte and reset sequences, varying all input bits.
verification.reset_timing: Toggle reset between rising edges and verify it has no immediate effect; verify reset wins at the rising edge.
verification.tools: Use specified Icarus v12 and matching vvp, -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, each under finite timeout. Preserve compile and simulation logs.
